steps.content: Schorl takes you away from the chaos in Augustus's luxury car. Inside, it's a whirlwind of activity: the little triangle interfaces with the autonomous driving system, activates anti-Mania scans to stabilize the contamination spreading through your body, and tirelessly attempts to raise Broken Blade Squad 3 on the battlefield.
Nearly forty minutes after you left the ball, Broken Blade Squad 3 finally responds to your call.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: Minos, this is Iron Mask. Combat operations are complete. All objectives secured. The after-action report will be forwarded by Siglinde. That is all.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You lost contact for a while.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: It was just signal interference from the intense Tide of Ashes, nothing to worry about. Your concern should be placed somewhere else—

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: We made contact with multiple giant Apostles. Externally controlled. Their size and threat level are off the charts, far beyond anything in our records. No way this was done by Aurum Secretum Sinners alone.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: We suspect a much stronger power source is nearby. That's the key that the enemy is using to summon and control the Apostles.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: Based on the Tide's activity patterns, whatever this thing is, it's likely connected to the missing BR-005.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I see.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: One more thing.
He pauses for a moment.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: We also engaged several Aurum Secretum wielders. Captured one alive—a female Sinner. Do we transfer her to MBCC?

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: If not, I will dispose of her on site.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Keep her alive. We're critically short on intel right now. I have a lot of questions for her.

steps.speaker: Scarface
steps.content: Awww, c'mon, another one alive?? Where's the fun in that? My teeth were just itching to meet her!
The noisy person on the other end of the communication is quickly silenced.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: No need. The General ordered us to fulfill all your requests. I'll have her transported to MBCC as soon as possible.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: Transportation will take longer until the Tide of Ashes subsides. Please have a reception team ready. Over.
[Dance Floor]
The ball is not yet over. In fact, your departure seems to have loosened tongues, and the guests have grown noticeably more talkative.

steps.speaker: Crowd A
steps.content: Will you look at that? This is the great defender we're all counting on? He can barely stand up straight, and those war hawks are still trying to rope him in? How are we supposed to fight Fraser with that?
steps.female_content: Will you look at that? This is the great defender we're all counting on? She can barely stand up straight, and those war hawks are still trying to rope her in? How are we supposed to fight Fraser with that?

steps.speaker: Crowd A
steps.content: I heard he's getting benched. The security departments had a big meeting over at Paradeisos, and he wasn't even there...
steps.female_content: I heard she's getting benched. The security departments had a big meeting over at Paradeisos, and she wasn't even there...

steps.speaker: Crowd B
steps.content: Guess he's just another stepping stone. That current DisCorps leader is the real problem. You hear what she did? Attacked the FAC Commander-in-Chief last year. And word is, twelve years ago... back in N.F. 103? She offed the previous one, too.
steps.female_content: Guess she's just another stepping stone. That current DisCorps leader is the real problem. You hear what she did? Attacked the FAC Commander-in-Chief last year. And word is, twelve years ago... back in N.F. 103? She offed the previous one, too.

steps.speaker: Crowd C
steps.content: My god. Is she trying to stage a coup? Is she just power-crazy, or is the FAC completely useless? Compared to her, MBCC is really just...

An alliance opposed to the mobilization order has begun to coalesce, with covert agitators actively fanning the flames through scandals and rumors. They whisper of atrocities from the old military's tyrannical reign, the unresolved mysteries of the N.F. 106 Observatory tragedy, the bitter rivalry between DisCity and the Outlands that sparked the one-year-long war, and fears of another Great Expo tragedy... and more.

Before long, a consensus emerges among the people: the armed forces within their own city-state seem more threatening than the hostile Outlanders poised beyond the walls. The memory of the old military's dictatorship feels closer, more visceral, than the faded history of the Independence War—and FAC's deep unpopularity is plain for all to see.
It is at this moment that Catherine returns to the hall.

Her eyes sweep across the room as though searching for someone. The wine glass in her hand has long been empty. An opportunist takes notice and glides to her side, holding two fresh glasses of fine wine.

Perhaps he is drawn by her expensive jewelry, or believes such beauty shouldn't stand alone—or maybe he recalls that she was the one ${PlayerName} left on the dance floor. Whatever the reason, his assessment is quick, and he moves to perform his version of gallantry.

steps.speaker: Male Socialite
steps.content: Madam, are you here alone? Allow me to introduce myself. I'm a humble businessman in the service of Paradeisos. Here's my card. And you are? I'd be honored if you'd join me for the next—

steps.speaker: Male Socialite
steps.content: Argh!!
A dinner knife—a flash of silver—arcs through the air and embeds itself in the back of his hand.

steps.speaker: Male Socialite
steps.content: What... Why would the knife... Wh-what did you do?!

Ignoring the man's choked scream entirely, Catherine strides forward without so much as a glance. As every head in the venue swivels toward her, she coolly scans the sea of startled faces, but her target remains elusive.
A tap on her sunglasses' frame activates the communicator. She listens to Schorl's message, and a soft sigh escapes her lips.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: Sigh... I was gone for five minutes. One phone call. And the Chief's gone already?

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: I just needed to win that battle first. If he'd just waited, my company would be his right now.
steps.female_content: I just needed to win that battle first. If she'd just waited, my company would be hers right now.

steps.content: In resignation, Catherine peels off her sunglasses and rubs the weariness from her eyes. Now, someone finally recognizes her.
[Scene Change] Battlefield Frontline
The battlefield is a scar of ruin. Steel rods and iron spikes have clawed the sandy earth to shreds. A few Apostles lie pinned to the ground, their forms slowly crumbling into ash.
In the midst of the devastation, the lone Outland prisoner strains against her bonds, howling with a raw mix of rage and terror.

steps.speaker: Aurum Secretum Captive
steps.content: ...What is this... Is this that woman's power? Why is it here...

steps.speaker: Aurum Secretum Captive
steps.content: Is she nearby?!!! Where are you! Show yourself!! I'll kill you!!!

steps.speaker: Scarface
steps.content: Gyahahaha! That look on your face! Bet you didn't see that coming. Our boss's like a super magneto queen. She doesn't even need to show up to wreck you. She can just snap your bones from hundreds of miles away.

steps.speaker: Scarface
steps.content: Anywhere the Shattered Blade points, Catherine Augustus's power follows. Total annihilation. So... you scared yet?

steps.speaker: Aurum Secretum Captive
steps.content: Go on, kill me, you DisCity dogs!! Do it! Or I swear I'll skin you alive, grind your bones into offerings, and turn every last one of you into—

steps.speaker: Aurum Secretum Captive
steps.content: Ugh!!
A rifle butt smashes against the base of her skull. The Outland warrior stiffens for a single, frozen moment before collapsing into unconsciousness. Then, Iron Mask hoists her up.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: Those are words for the dead. She is needed alive for a few more days.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: Get her to Nirvana Port and prep for shipment to DisCity. Augustus wants her delivered.

steps.speaker: Military Doctor
steps.content: Wait, what about the others?
With a smile, she indicates the desert bandits. It was they who supplied the vessels to transport the "Aurum Secretum device," provided cover, and assisted the two Outland warriors with its escort.
[Scene Change] Dance Floor
Someone trembles as they recognize her face.

steps.speaker: Crowd A
steps.content: ...I remember now! I saw that face in a portrait at <color=#fb9259>the Andohars'</color> gallery...

steps.speaker: Crowd A
steps.content: Her name... what was her name? It doesn't matter! The uniform... I remember the uniform in the painting now. It was a DisCorps uniform. My god... she's one of them!

Catherine had long forgotten the portrait. What she'd truly wanted was an equestrian piece, a vision of herself astride a powerful horse, styled after that pre-Nightfall painting of a general she so admired.

She surveys her surroundings; today's DisCity is utterly lacking in that kind of grandeur. The crowd around her grows restless—a vortex of averted eyes, stolen glances, and hushed whispers—their dread of her presence palpable.
As it should be. The common rabble ought to fear their betters. Yet... this level of dread is insufficient. It is not yet enough.
[Scene Change] Battlefield

The desert bandits fall to their knees, their desperate hands clutching the cold, unyielding metal of Iron Mask's legs. Witnessing his mercy toward the Outland captive has kindled a fragile hope, and now they beg, their pleas torn between ragged sobs.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit
steps.content: P-please!! We were just... we were just passing through! They made us do it!

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit
steps.content: We're done! We swear, we're done helping them! We'll... we'll help you! We'll tell you everything!!

steps.speaker: Military Doctor
steps.content: Alright, that's enough out of him. I'll take it from here.
The desert bandits watch, on the verge of tears, as she opens her medkit. Here is salvation: an angel tending to the wounds they suffered during their capture.
Then their angel reaches into the box. She retrieves two pistols, aiming neatly between their eyes with a smile.

steps.speaker: Crowd A
steps.content: But that painting... it was from forty years ago! Forty years! How is her face exactly the same... What in God's name is she?

Her declaration detonates another wave of panic, even wider this time. The room erupts into chaos; some shout for the guards while others scramble for the exits. Amidst the bedlam, Catherine merely watches, an amused smile playing on her lips as she contemplates whether to even bother answering these "youngsters."

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: An exceptional weapon is priceless. It stays sharp because it's cared for. It's ready because it's respected.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: ...Is that really so hard to understand? In your grip, even a masterpiece would be reduced to scrap. A waste of a perfect gift.

steps.speaker: Catherine
steps.content: Just by breathing, you make my blood run hot.
[Aurum Secretum device wreckage falls]

With a deafening crash, the glass dome of the banquet hall shatters. The lights cut out completely. Countless shards rain down as a twisted mass of metal, nearly two meters wide, thunders into the floor. Iron chains that bind it whip through the crowd, unleashing wave after wave of piercing screams.
Only now has Catherine Augustus Andohar ceased her power.

She used magnetism to haul it all the way here—not taxing, but time-consuming. If she hadn't been distracted providing support to Iron Mask and his team, it would have arrived much earlier. Unfortunately, she didn't make it in time.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: A little trophy from our latest battle. This is what's behind the Tide of Ashes, the very weapon they're using to ravage WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: I was going to give it to ${PlayerName} as a gift. Hauled it all the way back so he could see something interesting, something to shake off the gloom. But you drove him off before I got here.
steps.female_content: I was going to give it to ${PlayerName} as a gift. Hauled it all the way back so she could see something interesting, something to shake off the gloom. But you drove her off before I got here.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: So I guess you're the lucky ones who get the show instead.

With a mere flick of her finger, the iron chains groan to life, wrenching the deformed Aurum Secretum device from the crowd. It hangs, grotesque and suspended, as a shower of unidentifiable debris rains down upon the cowering crowd below.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Open your eyes. Take a good look. This is what the Outlanders spent years building. They broke every law, spilled their own blood, poured their hatred into it—all so they could cross the farlands and end your lives.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: And you? You think you can just betray your own, drop your guard, offer a few bribes, chant "long live peace," and go on living like nothing's wrong?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: How arrogant... You've never known real war. You've never even truly looked your enemy in the eye. All you care about is saving your own skins.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Listen up, you "peace-loving" people of DisCity. War is coming, and your army is coming back with it.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: That's right. These soldiers you fear—the ones with blood on their hands, shoulders heavy with sin, the so-called monsters beyond redemption—

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: They're the ones who rotted in hell so you could prosper. And how did you repay them? You threw them away.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: But never forget: your shiny throne is built on our corpses. The wine you drink is spilled from lives we took.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: You feast on blood and flesh, and yet you dare judge my soldiers? You dare?!

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Aaarrrgh! HELP!!
The fury in her voice echoes, a vibration that seizes the blood. Fear shatters their composure, and the first screams tear through the air.

Jolted back to their senses, the guests scramble for the exits—a panicked crawl on hands and knees, their strength sapped, unable to stand. In the oppressive dark, they are nothing but a herd of terrified livestock.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: The gutter you crawled from would reject your corpse. I won't give it the chance to dirty my blade.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Whatever the Outlanders can do, they can do better.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Mark my words, you cowards. War is coming, and none of you can stop it.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Everything we've lost... we'll take it back on the battlefield.
With her purpose fulfilled, she turns her back on the place, leaving without a second glance.
[Scene Change] Bureau
Meanwhile, you finally arrive at the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief! Where have you been? How are you feeling?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm fine.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How's the front line? I want a full report.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But you don't look well, Chief. You should have a medical check first.

steps.speaker: Option
options: I'm fine. How's the battle going?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...It's already over. They repelled the enemy and obtained vital intelligence.
You take the terminal, your eyes scanning every word of the battle report.
The stark, bloodstained numbers before your eyes dissolve into a soft sigh, then vanish entirely as the screen goes dark.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: It was just signal interference from the intense Tide of Ashes, nothing to worry about. Your concern should be placed somewhere else—
...Did that man omit the casualty figures because it was your decision? Did the strategy you chose lead to this cost?
<color=#fb9259>Why didn't he mention it earlier?</color>
The nausea from contamination surges again, and Nightingale quickly moves to offer support.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief! You need to steady yourself. These casualties are an unfortunate but ordinary part of warfare, unlike the typical operations in the city. The mission was a success. Please, trust that this is a victory.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Or... or perhaps we should withdraw from the operation? Your body isn't in any condition to handle more stress. I can submit the request right away—

steps.speaker: Option
options: ...It's fine. I've got it under control.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The shackles' Mania fluctuations don't always connect to my emotions. I'm not that emotionally volatile. It might be coming from BR-005... Since it's been going on all night, there's probably an external cause.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Maybe the Black Ring has moved closer. Could be why my sensitivity's spiking. I'll head to medical soon to see if they can pick up any new leads.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Just need a moment to rest. I'll go by myself... I need some time alone.
You let go of her hand. As you turn to leave, Schorl stops you.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Chief, try not to shoulder all the pressure yourself.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We have everything under control, and the backup plans are in motion. Your direct involvement isn't a requirement for this rescue. You can withdraw at any time. Please don't feel you have to push beyond your limits.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: War is, unfortunately, a constant in our era. We are equipped to manage it. You can trust us with this.
You walk alone through the Bureau's silent corridor. The late hour has stilled everything but the low, persistent thrum of Mania—a rhythm that pulses in your bones.
Surprisingly, the sensation isn't unpleasant.
Compared to the gilded masquerade of that ball, this raw truth—the cruelty, the suffering—feels more real. It cannot be ignored, and you will not look away.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: In your current state, no one in their right mind would put you on the frontlines.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: You can withdraw at any time. Please don't feel you have to push beyond your limits.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Help me...
You will not withdraw. You will take the field and finish this.
To win. To have your triumph. They started this war. They wielded the Black Ring to commit atrocities beyond forgiveness. You will defeat them, whatever the cost. You will not hesitate.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: These casualties are an unfortunate but ordinary part of warfare, unlike the typical operations in the city.

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Our promise... I'm sorry...

steps.speaker: Jasmine
steps.content: Don't mind it...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ugh...
Another wave of contamination surges through you, forcing you to halt. You draw a sharp breath to steady yourself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...It's the Black Ring's influence... It's close...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I have no reason to hesitate.
You step into the room and shut the door, fumbling in the darkness for the light switch.
That's when you feel it.
The air is thick, distorted. Your shackles stir restlessly as a wave of contamination seeps from the shadows. You are not alone.
You instinctively release your shackles, but you're a fraction of a second too slow.

Something crashes into your chest. Instantly, a violent shock of contamination resonates through your core, burning through your strength and hurling you back against the wall. The lights flicker on, revealing the face of your attacker.
[Hella Hug CG1] White flash fade in, sound effect, blank screen for 3 seconds

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You're...
Hearing your voice, the "person" in your arms slowly raises her head. The sight sends a thunderous ringing through your mind.
[Hella Hug CG2]

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hee...
[Quick flash: CG inside the Black Ring and Apostle visual (about 0.3 seconds) with distortion effects] [Followed by white screen, then fade to black screen after 1 second, text appears]
I'M BACK
